cards.ex: Breaking news: A major earthquake has struck near Osaka.
cards.exUz: So'nggi yangiliklar: Osaka yaqinida kuchli zilzila sodir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yaqinda sodir bo'lgan muhim voqea haqidagi yangi e'lon.

cards.ex: A source says the company is planning major layoffs.
cards.exUz: Manba xabar berishicha, kompaniya katta qisqartirishlarni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan manbadan olingan ma'lumotga ko'ra.

cards.ex: The video of the cat playing the piano went viral.
cards.exUz: Mushukning pianino chalayotgani videosi tarqalib ketdi.

cards.ex: The politician hired a spin doctor to improve his image.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi o'z imijini yaxshilash uchun soxtalashtiruvchini yolladi.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani yaxshiroq ko'rsatish uchun o'zgartiradigan shaxs.

cards.ex: The article buried the lead; I had to read three paragraphs to find out what happened.
cards.exUz: Maqola muhim ma'lumotni yashirdi; nima bo'lganini bilish uchun uchta xatboshini o'qishim kerak edi.

cards.ex: The newspaper was criticized for its use of yellow journalism.
cards.exUz: Gazeta sariq matbuot uslubidan foydalangani uchun tanqid qilindi.

cards.ex: The scandal hit the headlines and ruined his career.
cards.exUz: Janjal sarlavhalarga chiqdi va uning faoliyatini buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta yangilik bo'lib, gazetalarda paydo bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The article was just a puff piece designed to promote the new movie.
cards.exUz: Maqola shunchaki yangi filmni targ'ib qilish uchun yozilgan maqtov maqolasi edi.

cards.ex: The reporter managed to get the scoop on the celebrity divorce.
cards.exUz: Reportyor mashhur odamlarning ajrashishi haqida birinchi bo'lib xabar topishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

cards.ex: All articles are fact-checked before they are published.
cards.exUz: Barcha maqolalar chop etilishidan oldin faktlar tekshiriladi.

cards.ex: The magazine is going to press tonight, so we need to finalize everything.
cards.exUz: Jurnal bugun kechqurun bosilishga ketadi, shuning uchun biz hamma narsani yakunlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Gazeta yoki jurnal bosilishga tayyor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The politician stated his position on the record.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi o'z pozitsiyasini rasman e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Aytilgan gaplar ommaga e'lon qilinishi mumkin.

cards.ex: He told me something off the record, so I can't repeat it.
cards.exUz: U menga norasmiy gap aytdi, shuning uchun men uni takrorlay olmayman.

cards.ex: The government needs to be held to account for its actions.
cards.exUz: Hukumat o'z harakatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak.

cards.ex: Which news outlet do you trust the most?
cards.exUz: Siz qaysi axborot vositasiga eng ko'p ishonasiz?

cards.ex: The article included an eyewitness account of the fire.
cards.exUz: Maqolada yong'in guvohining hikoyasi bor edi.

cards.ex: The company is in damage control mode after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya janjaldan keyin zararni kamaytirish rejimida.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri harakatdan keyin vaziyatni yaxshilashga urinish.

cards.ex: He felt he was being subjected to a trial by media before the actual court case.
cards.exUz: U o'zini haqiqiy sud ishidan oldin ommaviy axborot vositalari orqali sud qilinayotgandek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalari orqali sud qilish.

cards.ex: The election results were front-page news.
cards.exUz: Saylov natijalari birinchi sahifadagi yangilik edi.

cards.ex: She's a reporter on the education beat.
cards.exUz: U ta'lim mavzusini yoritadigan reportyor.

cards.ex: The source code of the program was leaked online.
cards.exUz: Dasturning dastur kodi internetga sizib chiqdi.

cards.ex: The politician's sound bite was repeated on all the news channels.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining qisqa iqtibosi barcha yangiliklar kanallarida takrorlandi.
cards.uzDef: Televidenie yoki radioda ishlatiladigan qisqa, ta'sirchan gap.

cards.ex: The story was quickly forgotten in the 24-hour news cycle.
cards.exUz: Bu voqea 24 soatlik yangiliklar davrida tezda unutilib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangiliklar paydo bo'lishi va tarqalish davri.

cards.ex: The newspaper has a clear editorial slant towards the conservative party.
cards.exUz: Gazetaning konservativ partiyaga aniq muharrir qarashlari bor.
cards.uzDef: Gazeta yoki jurnalning siyosiy yoki shaxsiy fikri.

cards.ex: He's just an armchair critic; he's never actually done anything himself.
cards.exUz: U shunchaki bosh qotiruvchi tanqidchi; u hech qachon o'zi hech narsa qilmagan.
cards.uzDef: Tajribasiz, lekin hamma narsani tanqid qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what she really means.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nimani anglatishini tushunish uchun qatorlar orasidan o'qishingiz kerak.

cards.ex: Politicians know they are fair game for the media.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar ommaviy axborot vositalari uchun maqsadga loyiq ekanliklarini bilishadi.

cards.ex: I got wind of some rumors about the company's future.
cards.exUz: Men kompaniyaning kelajagi haqida ba'zi mish-mishlarni eshitib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida xabar topmoq, eshitmoq.

cards.ex: When asked about the scandal, he said 'no comment'.
cards.exUz: Janjal haqida so'rashganda, u 'izoh yo'q' dedi.

cards.ex: Keep me in the loop about any developments.
cards.exUz: Meni barcha yangiliklardan xabardor qilib turing.
